caption: The drawing consists of a single rectangular frame with a brown border. The upper portion contains a block of handwritten Spanish text in brown ink, occupying about one-fifth of the total area. The text is surrounded by a border decorated with a repeated pattern of stylized flowers and geometric shapes. Below the text, the main section of the drawing features a large square divided diagonally into four triangular segments by two intersecting lines, each marked with a serrated border. At the center, there is a circular shape that contains three stylized tulip-like floral motifs and one flower in each segment, all drawn in brown. The four triangular segments that radiate from the center are densely filled with additional stylized flowers, leaves, and plant forms. The space around the square is filled with a border composed of similar flower and plant motifs. The drawing is rendered on a cream or off-white background, and all elements are drawn in a single shade of brown ink.
title: Plate 1: Jemez Book of Marriages: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
